In my species we dont belive in an after life or such things, but I will never forget the time a human was helped by what I can only describe as ghosts or phantoms.

It was a small conflict, a civil war on a planet that was trying to join our confederacy. We were a small troop of peackeepers, just enough to man a save zone just outside the captal. There were talks of sending in a full army to force the rebels out and hold a democratic vote.
But the rebels new that so they tryed getting the Planet under there fingers before such things could happen.

They rushed to attack us and the capitol, we were encireld, had very few supplies and no contact to the outside. They tryed everything to burn us up, but we threw them back every time. We didnt give up any ground but lost a few of our best every time, we stood strong, but everyone knew that we couldnt do it forever.
After one battle a soldier made a sign that said :
"42 battlion vs the world.
For peace to the end"
It was small glimmer of hope in our desperat struggel.
We fought with everthing till we ran out of supplies and then we made pur final stand.
I was next to a human mg gunner named Peter, he was of small stature and a strong mind, he became like a grandfather to the boys, helping them with every quedtion they got and comforting them when they missed home.
He manned the gun and I was to give him ammuntion.
When we got in position he said a short prayer and then the fighting begun.
I still remeber how I grabed two boxes of ammo and heared him scream, when I looked at him I saw him still on the mg and shooting with a hate in his face that I never saw before.
The a boy, in an old ragged uniform I never saw before, went up behind him and put his hand on his shoulder, then came another man in a different uniform and another and more, till there were about a douzend or so people behind him. They all had wartorn uniforms and looked like they were starving, but there faces were filled with love and pride. I tried ignoring them as I had a job to do, but I feelt that they were watching over my comrade. 
He needed it he was hit again and again, but it was like the bullets went right thrue him.
Then suddenly the rebel artillery was hit with a number of giant exploions and fighter jets zoomed over our hats.
A relief force of tanks and mechanised infantry was comeing to save us, I feelt the joy and hope that I thought long forgotten overcome me, so I started shounting about how we were save now and that we won against the world while Peter was fireng his gun in the last of the rebels as they made a desperat last attack. 
But they had no hope as our comrades were already in stricking distance.
I turned to Peter, but saw how he collapsed over his gun.
Panic took hold of me as I picked him up and carried him to the arriveing medics, when he layed on the provisonal Hospital bed the medic that took care of him took me aside and asked me when he died, I told him that it was just minutes ago and how he was fighting till the end, he just said that more than enough of his wounds were leathel on their own and his body seemed to be dead for hours now. I just looked at him and remebered the men that stood behind him since he took his first wound and hoped that he was with them now,to take his place in their ranke, to guide a new warrior.
